selection_rationale: Higher-impression candidates in the same 5–20 position band were materially optimized on 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-02 and remain in active measurement windows. The target page's 2026-08-31 change only linked shared entity IDs in Article schema and did not alter its content, metadata or search intent.

baseline.source: Google Search Console Search Analytics API

experiment_isolation.last_page_change_scope: Article author and publisher changed from duplicate inline entities to shared @id references only

serp_observation.method: Limited Turkish web-search snapshot, not a personalized Google rank measurement
serp_observation.dominant_intent: Informational explanation of emotions that may accompany anger, why anger appears, and practical ways to notice the pattern
serp_observation.observed_gap: The existing page asserted that anger is generally secondary, lacked a nuanced answer-first distinction, a bounded observation procedure, visible authorship/recency, verified sources and FAQ schema.

acceptance_contract: Keep the existing URL and exact canonical
Answer the target query directly without claiming anger always hides another emotion
Explain that anger can be primary, secondary or co-occurring depending on context and function
Name common accompanying experiences without turning a list into self-diagnosis
Provide a four-step functional observation procedure that does not excuse harmful behavior
Add an explicit safety boundary for violence, threats, loss of control and urgent risk
Show author, publication date, update date, editorial boundary and verified peer-reviewed/NHS sources
Align Article citation, dateModified and speakable with visible content
Keep visible FAQ answers identical to FAQPage JSON-LD
Track hero and body CTA surfaces through consent-gated generic analytics markers
Add one contextual inbound link from the stable relationship-problems page
Update sitemap lastmod and complete-tier daily P0 query monitoring

evaluation.low_volume_caution: The baseline contains only two impressions. A single new impression or isolated average-position movement is insufficient to declare a win.
